narrative.details:
Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together.  Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.

I, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
narrative.objectives: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Beaststalker's Boots, Beaststalker's Pants and Beaststalker's Mantle.
narrative.offerRewardText:
This curse was bestowed upon us but for a mere medallion. Lord Valthalak certainly knows how to hold a grudge.

We'll endeavor to find the remaining pieces - hopefully before I meet an untimely demise. But before that, let us see about your reward.
narrative.requestItemsText: You've returned and I see in your eyes that you've much to tell me, adventurer.  Let us take care of your reward first.

chain.subtitle: 25 quests at level 60, 177,000 XP in all.

quests.name: Anthion's Strange Request
quests.objectiveText: Bring 3 Dark Iron Bars, 20 Enchanted Leather, 3 Mooncloth and 4 Cured Rugged Hides to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Anthion's Old Friend
quests.objectiveText: Take the incomplete Banner of Provocation to Falrin Treeshaper at the library in Dire Maul.

quests.name: Falrin's Vendetta
quests.objectiveText: Collect 25 Ogre Warbeads from Ogres inside Dire Maul or Blackrock Spire and return to Falrin Treeshaper inside the Athenaeum in Dire Maul.

quests.name: The Instigator's Enchantment
quests.objectiveText: Bring the following to Falrin Treeshaper inside Dire Maul: 1 Jeering Spectre's Essence, 4 Dark Runes and 8 Large Brilliant Shards.

quests.name: The Challenge
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths and place the Banner of Provocation in its center as you are sentenced by High Justice Grimstone.

quests.name: Anthion's Parting Words
quests.objectiveText: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Beaststalker's Boots, Beaststalker's Pants and Beaststalker's Mantle.

quests.name: Bodley's Unfortunate Fate
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Mountain and use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to find Bodley near Blackrock Spire.

quests.name: Three Kings of Flame
